scripts.release:build: node scripts/check-release-toolchain.mjs && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && node scripts/with-env.mjs tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json -- --locked
scripts.release:build:windows:nsis: node scripts/check-release-toolchain.mjs && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && node scripts/with-env.mjs tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis -- --locked
